name: How long does stucco resurfacing take?

mainEntity.name: How long does stucco resurfacing take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stucco resurfacing depends on several factors, including the size of your home, the extent of any necessary prep work, and weather conditions. Generally, for an average-sized home, the process can take anywhere from a few days to a week. This timeline includes cleaning, minor repairs, and the application of the new stucco layers. Our team in Pasadena will provide a more precise estimate after assessing your specific property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco resurfacing typically takes a few days to a week for an average-sized home, depending on size, prep work, and weather.
